# WealthBoost

> WealthBoost is an AI goal coach for iPhone and iPad. A user describes a legitimate business, project, product, income direction, or practical change, and WealthBoost provides tailored perspectives, useful ideas, practical next steps, and contextual AI Coach answers.

Canonical website: https://wealthboost.app/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6756603789
Language: English
Platforms: iPhone and iPad
Current product generation: WealthBoost 3.0

## Important facts

- WealthBoost does not require bank-account access and does not process financial transactions.
- WealthBoost provides educational guidance and planning support, not financial, legal, tax, health, or investment advice.
- The app is personalized using details the user chooses to provide, including the goal, audience, desired result, current situation, available time, budget range, country, currency, and whether the activity is local, online, or both.
- New users can currently explore the full app for three days. Subscription plans and local prices are displayed by the App Store.
- The official support contact is devpaulcrp@gmail.com.
